{{Quote|I warned you. Working with Aurra Sing is bad business.|Fong Do, to Castas|<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">{{TCW|Lethal Trackdown}}</ref>}}
'''Fong Do''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] who lived in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One of his friends was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Castas/Legends|Castas]], who contacted him from [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] after he quit a job with [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. Fong had previously warned him about dealing with her but Castas quickly dismissed that revealing he had valuable information, most likely concerning Aurra. Before Castas could reveal the information to him, which Do seemed interested in, he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Sing. Later he was recounting the event to a [[Unidentified Weequay pirate (Moshi Bar)/Legends|Weequay Pirate]], who was a member of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka's]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]], in a tavern called [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]]. Realizing that he was being spied on by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Do pulled out his two knives and would have attacked her had [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] not intervened. Like the rest of the thugs in the bar he was taken by Ahsoka's distraction and let the eavesdropper get away. He was later seen at [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] when [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and his son [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|Ion]] were tracking [[Greedo the Elder|Greedo]].
